issue: ArrayMesh normal array was assumed byte-identical to original float32 normals; actual GPU restored packed normals differ, vertices match exactly
scope: Development failure, not accepted; independent source diagnosis required before tolerance adjustment

diagnosis.cause: ArrayMesh default normal storage uses octahedral encoding, two uint16 components and decoding even when attribute compression flag is off
diagnosis.correction: Independently predict float32/octencode/uint16 truncation/decode/normalize and compare at 1e-9; retain vertex 1e-9m check, no arbitrary tolerance expansion
